recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結中，副皮質區（paracortex）被大片淡粉紅色、細胞較稀疏的區域擴張，把深藍色的小淋巴球區推擠成不規則的島狀，淋巴結構仍保留、被膜完整；這種淡染副皮質結節是皮膚病性淋巴結病變（dermatopathic lymphadenopathy）的低倍線索。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with intact capsule and subcapsular region
Marked expansion of the paracortex by broad pale-staining zones
Pale zones contain loosely arranged cells with abundant pale cytoplasm (histiocytes/interdigitating dendritic cells)
Residual dark small-lymphocyte areas and a follicle-like aggregate compressed between pale zones
Rare dark pigment focus; melanin cannot be confirmed at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows preserved architecture with an intact capsule. The paracortex is expanded by broad, pale-staining nodular zones composed of cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with histiocytes and interdigitating/Langerhans-type dendritic cells, which separate residual dark lymphoid areas and follicles. No sheets of atypical cells or effacement are seen at this power; pigment-laden macrophages cannot be reliably assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy; clinical history of chronic dermatitis and exclusion of early mycosis fungoides involvement are recommended.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes in the paracortex with partial effacement and clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than only reactive histiocytes and dendritic cells.
LCH shows sinus-based infiltrates of grooved Langerhans cells with abundant eosinophils and necrosis, whereas dermatopathic change is paracortical with scattered melanophages.
cHL shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background, which are absent in dermatopathic lymphadenopathy.
